name: aits-marketplace
description: AITS — Adaptive Intelligence Thinking System. A multi-agent decision-making framework evolved from de Bono's Six Thinking Hats, with a runtime-neutral spec and a deterministic engine.

plugins.name: aits
plugins.description: AITS 3.0 — 11 cognitive agents, 4 commands, 7 playbooks and 10 execution graphs, enforced by a deterministic engine (MCP server and hook): inviolable rules and human gates, hash-chained decision log, model-diversity policy, semantic memory and calibration.
